global: This is a bowl of miso ramen, its rich, amber broth glistening under warm light. Topped with shredded cabbage and menma, it sits in a white bowl with a red rim, set against a dark table with a glass nearby.

regions.background: Dark wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and slight sheen from ambient light reflection.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with glossy finish, featuring a bold red circular rim and smooth, curved interior surface.
regions.soup: Miso ramen broth, rich orange-brown, glossy surface with visible noodles and toppings, topped with shredded vegetables and chili flakes.
regions.spoon: A white plastic spoon with smooth, slightly curved surface and rounded tip, partially submerged in broth.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear as glossy, brownish, sliced pieces with visible fibrous texture and slight caramelization on their surfaces.
